name: Spotify Technology S.A.
blurb: Spotify Technology S.A. is a global audio streaming service provider operating through Premium and Ad-Supported segments. The Premium segment offers ad-free, on-demand access to music, podcasts, and audiobooks, while the Ad-Supported segment provides limited on-demand access with advertisements. As of early May 2026, Spotify holds a market capitalization of approximately $87.4 billion and is a dominant player in the audio streaming industry.
recent: In the past 30 days, Spotify reported strong earnings on April 28, 2026, with net income surging 132.2% year-over-year to $3.12 billion. The stock has experienced volatility, trading between $405 and $785 over the past 52 weeks, and closed at $425.25 on May 6, 2026. Analysts maintain a Strong Buy consensus with a price target of $671.09.
